title: Paul McCartney live: Co-op Live, Manchester | 2024
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Co-op Live arena in Manchester, England, on 14 December 2024.

It was the 56th show of the Got Back Tour, which lasted for 80 dates between April 2022 and November 2025, and the first of two consecutive nights in Manchester.

The setlist was notable for the first performance of ‘Wonderful Christmastime’ since 2018.

View this post on Instagram

A post shared by Paul McCartney (@paulmccartney)

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums), Kenji Fenton (saxophone), Mike Davis (trumpet), and Paul Burton (trombone).
